mostWorthwhile.text: Cooling the gas envelope was most worthwhile: it showed why losing energy allows a growing core to accumulate more gas.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial core-building step was relatively predictable, though it established the material needed for the later contrast.

surprise.text: I expected the later core to interact with the dispersing disk immediately, but it first needed to gather rock and volatiles. The feedback performed that step automatically.

arbitrary.text: Using open space to cool the envelope was a plausible inference, though the pairing was somewhat abstract.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how these contrasting formation paths affect the later development of worlds.
